description.value:
Your spellcraft draws upon an area or surface within range that shows a timelapsed formation of magic; it could be stylized art or writing, it could be your projected voice narrating a scene, or the formation of an image or sculpture. Regardless, it draws the attention of onlookers as it shows the entire process of your work over the duration.

When you Cast or Sustain the spell, creatures in the area need to make a Will saving throw. If your visionary skill is Crafting or Deception, they take a -2 circumstance penalty to their save. Creatures who fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the display, and you also become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to creatures who critically fail. You remain Hidden to creatures who are Fascinated by the display, unless you take a hostile action or another noticeable action (such as casting a spell while in sight).

You can add an ephemeral catalyst to enhance this spell. If you do, the spell gains a range of 60 feet and takes 3 actions to cast. While the spell is ongoing, you can surprise onlookers by Casting a Spell that matches the magic on display. If you do, you can use the displayed spectacle as the point of origin for the spell. If you are Hidden to a creature or if a creature is Fascinated by the display at the time you Cast the Spell, that creature takes a -2 status penalty to their AC or saving throw against your spell. Timelapse Spectacle then ends.
